ResourceHeader.Description: Operational Level 0B image data from the Compact Coronagraph-1 (CCOR-1) aboard the GOES-19 spacecraft. The data are generated from paired Level 0A images containing the outer (T1) and inner (N2) portions of the CCOR-1 field of view. During Level 0B processing, the Level 0A image data are combined and geometrically rectified to form a full-frame white-light coronagraph image. The resulting images have dimensions of 2048 by 1920 pixels and are provided in FITS format with pixel values in digital numbers (DN). World Coordinate System (WCS) and spacecraft ephemeris information are populated in the FITS headers. The images have not yet been radiometrically calibrated. The data are produced at an approximately 15-minute cadence.

Parameter.Name: FITS Extension #1 White-Light Image Data
Parameter.Description: The first FITS extension contains a 2048 by 1920 pixel full-frame white-light coronagraph image in digital numbers (DN), generated by combining the outer (T1) and inner (N2) Level 0A image data. The image is geometrically rectified during Level 0B processing. World Coordinate System (WCS) information is populated in the FITS header. The image data are internally compressed using GZIP_1. The Level 0B images have not yet been radiometrically calibrated. The CCOR-1 spectral range is approximately 480 to 730 nm.
